findings.value: Live gigs (for example Goblyns + Oral Habit), with DJ nights on other evenings: Scared To Dance guest-DJ nights (songs by artists such as Talking Heads), a vinyl Sweet Dreams Soul & Disco night and the new Caliente club night (reggaeton, baile funk).

evidence.quote: Scared To Dance is back at The Shacklewell Arms!
Expect to hear Talking Heads, Fontaines D.C, Blondie, Wet Leg, David Bowie
Caliente is a brand new club night at the Shacklewell Arms brought to you by underground queen Kuntessa.
Expect Latin ass shaking bangers, reggaeton and baile funk all night till late.
